public_rationale: The available launch evidence supports both parts of the claim. A February 18, 2025 observation identifies full o3's omission from the livestream chart [e1]. DeepLearning.AI's February 19 report identifies three core benchmark families—AIME 2024, GPQA and LiveCodeBench—and lists o3-mini at high effort among the reasoning-model comparisons [e2]. Together, these support a small set of reported benchmark families and no presented comparison with full o3 [e1, e2].
limitations: The complete primary launch charts were not readable, so the evidence does not establish an exhaustive benchmark count.
The public comparisons do not establish whether xAI privately tested full o3 or had access to it.
